assertions.requirement: Cursor info, references, rename, and semantic tokens agree on the authored token span for a source-backed template member.
Cursor-locus queries that accept line and character resolve the same semantic member as offset-aware queries for the same source position.
Unproven weak/dynamic member references return only proven rows, preserve candidates separately, and mark the answer open.
App-level diagnostic aggregation preserves the template diagnostic subject, selected member identity, suggestion action, source, and domain.
Edit-bearing template code actions carry explicit oldText and validate insertion/replacement text against authored source.

assertionSets.requirement: Public app-query catalog rows preserve the cursor/source-file/paging/materialization boundary that IDE, MCP, and contract callers use to choose safe query shapes.
Template semantic tokens preserve exact authored token spans for Aurelia syntax and expression surfaces.
Paged template semantic tokens preserve exact authored spans for plugin syntax, controllers, router resources, and composition resources.
Template folding ranges and inlay hints preserve authored source spans and distinguish implicit helper hints from explicitly authored syntax.
Bindable property and explicit public-attribute alias surfaces preserve distinct references and rename edit plans.
Explicit custom-element resource references and rename plans use exact public-name declaration and tag-token sources.
Template diagnostics preserve diagnostic kind, missing-input vocabulary, selected symbol, suggestion action, and authored source.
Compiler diagnostics preserve framework-code vocabulary and authored source ownership.
Missing plugin capability diagnostics preserve the concrete framework capability and authored syntax source.
Template overlay diagnostics preserve TypeScript code identity while retaining authored template source and semantic subject spans.
Template completions preserve binding-scope visibility, checker member metadata, and Aurelia hook facts without losing state-projected owner types.
Template code actions distinguish safe edit plans from diagnostic-only suggestions and preserve exact edit provenance, oldText, and action affordance metadata.

Framework capability demand rows preserve the capability key, admission/actionability state, module recommendation, authored syntax source, and related diagnostic lane before presentation diagnostics are assembled.
Template-controller scope constructs preserve Aurelia binding-context, override-context, branch-local, parent-scope, resource, diagnostic, and edit-plan semantics through public query answers.
